Line.Talk: Ah…  This is the D-Terminal-Dungeon I used to visit.
Eugghh?!  Who… who is it?!
*snickers* @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, you have made it here.  Not bad!
I will have a powerful tamer, too!  This is great!
I bet Dats Center is working around the clock to catch me.
Haha!  I seek a powerful tamer!  Catch me if you can!  Hahaha!
It was @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> that's been chasing after me all this time? Pathetic.. All that for mere digimons..
So, did you like the Dark Tower I made?
I'm here to say a quick hello.  I will hear your review later.  Hahahaha!
I am Devimon, the most powerful and the most evil digimon.  I trust that you have heard of my renown at least once?
You have made it to D-Terminal 2F.  You are stronger than I could have known.
But, you will have spent much of your energy getting here.  This gives me the upper hand!
Mwahahaha!  Did you think you could defeat me with that pathetic power of yours?
If we cross paths again, you will receive the devil's baptism with Death Claw.  I will make your tomb where you stand!
How dare you challenge me and my plan to take over this world with the Black Cogwheel!
Very well!  If you will survive so tenaciously, I will eliminate your kind one by one.  Mwahahaha!
Bang, bang!  I am <Justice Spirit> Deputymon of the Digimon Farm!
Howdy and I welcome y'all to the Digimon Farm.  The searing heat is this place's charm.  Hahaha!
If y'all got any questions, make sure y'all ask me.
Of course, that offer is open to all the <Ladies>.
Anywho, when y'all got the time for it, let's talk over a cup o' cold milk!
Greetings.  I am Hawkmon.  I've just returned from a trip.  It is nice to meet you.
I am a descendant of a unique race that once prospered in the ancient times. I can't tell you all the details right now, though.
Those whom I have encountered on my journey have told me that I am respectful and polite.
I count myself cool-headed and calm in general.
What do you think of my head piece?  I've received this from Garudamon whom I most highly respect.  I cherish it deeply.
When I returned alone from the trip with my partner, Inoue,
I saw that digimons around here were all on a rampage.
I also noticed a few humans in the area.
I will begin an investigation into this matter step-by-step.
I would greatly appreciate your assistance in my investigation, tamer.
I am Pajiramon.  You have come seeking me, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>?
You do understand that I am one of the Great Twelve, do you not?  Hahaha!
The Great Twelve refer to the twelve beasts, that is, the twelve zodiac digimons.
Do I know who Devimon is?  I have never seen such a digimon in this area...  (@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>
I have a favor to ask of you.  It should not be that difficult for you.
Fine, fine.  Just... do me this favor, would you?  This is urgent.
Ugh…  We've finally made it to the first floor of the Maze.
It is still… heart-wrenching to think about them…  Pray that they will find a place of comfort in their death.
Anyway, we should begin our search in this area.
As you know, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, the structure of this Maze is quite complex.
If you are not careful, you will easily be lost.
Now, then, let's start by searching the first floor of the Digimon Maze thoroughly.
Ta-da!  Enter the genius once again!
Hahaha!  You don't need to be so surprised.  I am always one step ahead of you all.
Eh?  What am I doing here, you ask?  Well… it's… err… none of your business!
Anyway, it looks like I, the brilliant Master Investigator, must come to the rescue yet again.
Someone is likely conspiring not to allow anyone to the upper floors.
Now, assist me and search the surrounding areas.
We will certainly find the culprit behind this!
The Maze was mine to protect.My responsibility was to protect the ancient artifacts and treasures in this place.
Digimon Kaiser seized this place and sealed my body away.Since then,the safety of this place has been compromised.
Digimon Kaiser is conducting some kind of an ongoing experiment.
Not a day goes by without the screams of digimons in the upper floors.
I am certain that he is up to no good.  Please, stop Digimon Kaiser and recover my body.
I will let you through to the upper floor.
If we restore the Maze to the way it used to be, I should be able to find my body as well.
Please remember that the only way to stop him is for me to find my body.
At last, we are on the second floor.
A new place calls for a new attitude.
Let's start our search again.  It's a brand new day!
The second floor of the Maze seems even more complex than that of the first floor.
If you are not careful, you will easily be lost.
Now!  Let's leave no stone unturned on this second floor of the Digimon Maze.
Yeah, baby!  Woo hoo!  I am Etemon, the most powerful digimon in existence!
What?  Why am I in a place like this, you ask?  Curious, are you?
Shut yer cakehole!  It ain't none of your business.
I like to be noticed by others anytime, anywhere.
And I'm violent to boot.  Mwahahahaha!
No matter.  I have my reasons for being here, so don't go on prying.
Ta-da!  Enter the ingenious Master Investigator once again!
Oh?  Aren't you the ones that I ran into on the first floor?
We run into each other on the first floor by chance, and then we do the same on the second floor…  Chance?
Perhaps… you are stalking me?  Or, perhaps, this is a sign of incredible respect for me?
this Maze is complex.This has to be someone's conspiracy.A trick to keep this Master Investigator trapped in this place.
Now, assist me and search the surrounding areas.
We will certainly find the culprit behind this!

At last, we are on the third floor.
We will need to calmly look around in this area.
Let's not give up but keep pushing ourselves.
This third floor of the Digimon Maze seems have a symmetrical, mirror-image structure.
Again, if you are not careful, you will easily be lost.
Now!  Let's leave no stone unturned on this third floor of the Digimon Maze.
Yeah, baby!  Woo hoo!  I am Etemon, the most powerful digimon in existence!
We meet again!
Shut yer cakehole!  It ain't none of your business.  How many times do I have to tell you?
I am the best of the best!
Hahaha!  I am Etemon, the most handsome and powerful digimon!
You just put your faith in me, Etemon, the most powerful king of digimons.
Ta-da!  Enter the ingenious Master Investigator once again!
What was that frown that crossed your face?
I see.  The quick frown totally gives you away.
You are… full of respect for moi!  Hahaha!
I don't blame you…  Anyway, I want to exit this complex Maze.
Now, you will assist me - the one you oh-so-respect - and search this area step-by-step!
We will certainly find the culprit who is in hiding somewhere!

*snickers* At last, you are here.  Welcome.  Shall we begin this party? *snickers*
Finally, after all that trouble, you've made it to the fourth and the final floor, tamer!
I can't believe it was Digimon Kaiser that we've been chasing after all this time…
I will show him no mercy!
To think of all those who were sacrificed because of him... Grrrr!
Tamer, I'm counting on you.
I know you can do it.
Yeah, baby!  Woo hoo!  I am Etemon, the most powerful digimon in existence!
What?  That's Digimon Kaiser?  And you've been chasing after him all along?
Well…  It really has nothing to do with me, but…
You work for me, Etemon the Great, "the Most Powerful Digimon in Existence" and the "King of Digimons".
Go and get Kaiser.  Make a bun out of him.
You just need to follow after me!  But once we are there, you're pretty much on your own.  Hahaha!
See?  I knew it!  I just knew it!
Digimon Kaiser was the culprit!
My deduction was 100% right!
Not a word of a lie - it was so accurate that it gives me the chill!
Now that I have successfully found out the culprits with my fantastically brilliant brain,
I will give you the honor of wrapping this up.
Not only am I the most brilliant Master Investigator, I am also VERY generous!
Hmm…  We have finally come to the end of the Digimon maze…  You must be exhausted.
We have solved many challenging puzzles, and finally came to where we are today. A lot has happened since we first began.
It seems that my role here is done.
The rest is up to you.
Seeing your progress so far, I'm sure you will do just fine.
Chief Leomon was looking for you, so go and see him.
How can this be?!  Everything was perfect!
This… this is a nightmare!  What a terrible ending…
Now that it has come to this…, I will start everything all over again!  Everything!!
I will reset the Digital World.
I will…  I will return home first, and wipe all data from the computer…
And… and… I will start right from the beginning again!!!
Don't think this is over!  (He disappears into the distance.)
Digimons and humans should never have met in the first place.
But, I changed my mind after witnessing the love between that human from before and a digimon.
(He seems to be talking about Keenan Krier and Yukidarumon.)
Right now, he doesn't understand
what it is that he should truly hate…
SaberLeomon!  Unless you change your mind,
the world of digimons will have no future!
What do you know, human?  How dare you speak to me!
I never speak with humans.
Every terrible thing that is happening in the Digital World
is because of you humans.
You claim to protect the Digital World…  Hrmph!  What a joke!
Take this message to Mercurymon, too,
that I will never ever listen to him!
Ah…  It is you…
I was worried that Digimon Kaiser, the source of evil,
seized the Maze and sealed my body, compromising the safety of this place…
Yet, you have defeated him and helped me recover my body.  Words cannot describe my gratitude to you.
Now, as the guardian of this Maze, I will continue to protect ancient artifacts and treasures.
Let me tell you a story…
Once upon a time, the Primeval Digital Era comes to an end,
and the Ancient Digital Era began.
Yet, peace never came.
Humanoid digimons and beast digimons began their fight.
The cause of this fight traces back to the Three Great Angels.
Seraphimon and Ophanimon loved humanoid digimons.
However, Cherubimon, an angel digimon in the form of a beast, loved beast digimons.
The will of the Three Great Angels was divided, and Cherubimon declared war on humanoid digimons.
The war raged on.
Then, a digimon by the name of Lucemon suddenly appeared.  He stopped the war and restored peace.
But, before long, Lucemon became corrupt.  He went into the Fallen Mode and began to threaten the entire Digital World.
until the Ten Warriors appeared, sealed Lucemon, and disappeared leaving their spirits behind.
However, this was all in the past.
Still, Mercurymon and SaberLeomon open a new chapter,
and a new story is about to begin.
A new story of war between humanoid digimons and beast digimons.
Did you think this was over?  The story has not yet come to an end…  It never will…
Who is that??
Halt, you humans of the Real World!
I am Gallantmon of the Royal Knights, the guardians of the Digital World.
You humans are no doubt the cause of the series of events that are currently taking place.
However, your actions have all been for the benefit of the Digital World.
I will continue to keep my eyes on you.  It will do you well to remember to be on your best behavior.
Fools…  This is where you stop!
Let's test out my Gizumon, shall we? *snickers*
Kkkkrrrkkk…  Kkkrrrrrrkk…
Hmm…  This tower is useless now.
Ah, Dr. Kurata, you are here!  I believe you know what it is I wish to speak to you about?
Hahaha!  I see.  So, you are Digimon Kaiser.  I can accept your terms, but…
I'm sure you understand that you will have to return the favor.
I need the power of the Dark Tower you have constructed!
Ha!  I highly doubt that you will be able to control its power as a mere human.
Listen, Kaiser.  If you and I put our strength together, we will be able to execute the plans more quickly.
Much more quickly than you might think possible…  What do you say?  Won't you work with me?
Hahahaha!!!  Is that so?  Very well!  I shall let you borrow the power of my Dark Tower.
But remember this one thing…  This world belongs to me.
Of course… *snickers*
Tamer @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> travels from the Dark Tower Wasteland to the Digimon Maze Entrance.
We're here.  This is the Digimon Maze Entrance I mentioned earlier.
It's your first time here.  You will probably lose your way easily.
There are fearsome digimons here and there in this place.
You are too weak to enter the Entrance safely.
I'm rather busy right now, so I won't be able to go right to the Entrance,
but I will at least accompany you near the Entrance, so relax.
I'll go slow.  Stay close.  (*runs off*)
(Shows up flying)  Ta-da!  Hahaha!
I am SuperStarmon, the immortal master investigator with style and the looks!!  Hahaha!
Now, why would you be loitering about here?
This place is far too dangerous for rookies like yourselves.
How did you end up so weak?  Had some traumatic experiences in your youth or something?  Ha!
You should just gain more experience in the area.
Anyway, I am desperately needed elsewhere.  Ciao!  Hehehe! (Creepy laughter)
Teehee...  How long will you stay alive here, I wonder?  *chuckles*
(Huffing and puffing)  We have finally made it to the 2nd floor of the Digimon Maze...
This place is much quieter than I had expected.  Almost too quiet...
Let's be careful and move on one step at a time.
Anyway, if you want to exit the Maze, just tell me anytime.
(Slowly coming to) Have you broken the seal that has bound me for so long?
Have you heard of the Great Twelve of the digimon world?
They are the mouse, the ox, the tiger, the rabbit, the dragon, the snake, the horse, the sheep, the monkey, the chicken, the dog, and the boar.
There is a digimon for each animal: <Mouse / Kumbhiramon>, <Ox / Vajramon>, <Tiger / Mihiramon>, <Rabbit / Antylamon>,
<Dragon / Majiramon>, <Snake / Sandiramon>, <Horse / Indramon>, <Sheep / Pajiramon>,
<Monkey / Makuramon>, <Chicken / Sinduramon>, <Dog / Caturamon>, and <Boar / Vikaralamon>.
These are the <Great Twelve>.
March is the month of the <Dragon / Majiramon>.
For one month, as you defeat enemy digimons scattered throughout the area, you will be able to collect the <Crystals of the Great Twelve>.
When you gather them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.
Have you heard of the White Day?
It is a day when men give women sweets as a gift and profess their love to them.
If you find someone you love, make sure you give her a candy.
Hmm?  I know a lot?  All I did was to borrow the information from the Digital World.
I may not look much, but I am a digital monster (digimon).  Don't forget that!
Anyway, in order to do the Candy [Achievement Quest],
you need <Gold Candy>, <White Candy>, and <Black Candy>, 5 of each.
If you bring them to me, I will grant you the White Day achievement.
You have completed Valentine's Day [Achievement Quest] and White Day [Achievement Quest]!
Let me give you a special item.
Thank you for carrying out achievement quests consistently.  Here, take this gift from me. :)
I look forward to working with you more!

Title: [Quest] The Great Twelve on the Move

Line.Talk: By now, you probably know more about the Great Twelve than I do!
They are the mouse, the ox, the tiger, the rabbit, the dragon, the snake, the horse, the sheep, the monkey, the chicken, the dog, and the boar.
There is a digimon for each animal: <Mouse / Kumbhiramon>, <Ox / Vajramon>, <Tiger / Mihiramon>, <Rabbit / Antylamon>,
<Dragon / Majiramon>, <Snake / Sandiramon>, <Horse / Indramon>, <Sheep / Pajiramon>,
<Monkey / Makuramon>, <Chicken / Sinduramon>, <Dog / Caturamon>, and <Boar / Vikaralamon>.
The power of the <Great Twelve> will be activated.
Now that you have gathered them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.
You have worked hard for a year.
I hope you have a great day with lots of privileges.
Hi!  My name is Miki.  Nice to meet you, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>
I am responsible for retrieving and scanning DigiEggs.
Retrieving DigiEggs is a basic task that a Dats member must carry out often.
While we are at it, let's retrieve a <Retrieval DigiEgg>.
I am told that <Inoue Papa> has a <Retrieval DigiEgg> in Yokohama Village.
Find <Inoue Papa> and bring me the <Retrieval DigiEgg>.
Hello.  I'm Inoue's papa.  Pleased to meet you, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>.
Your @<tc:900>#<my_dname>@</tc> looks healthy, running around.
But the best way to health is by prevention.
<Retrieval DigiEggs> are something of a loot that you can find when you win in battle against regular digimons.
Dats Center retrieves them and safely returns them to the Digital World.
This is common knowledge for a Dats member.  Take this to Miki.  She is responsible for all retrievals.  Good luck.
Did you know that DigiEggs are largely grouped into three categories?  No?  Then, let me tell you.
First, there are Retrieval DigiEggs which can only be retrieved.
Secondly, there are DATA Scan DigiEggs which contain DATA that can be scanned.
Thirdly, there are Mercenary DigiEggs from which you can gain mercenary digimons.
These are the three types of DigiEggs.
DigiEggs with DATA can be scanned for items.
But you need to pay for the scanning, so keep that in mind.
Now, then, let's bring a <DATA Scan DigiEgg>, shall we?
Sarah Damon in Yokohama Village stumbled upon a <DATA Scan DigiEgg> at her home.
Go quickly and retrieve it.
Hello.  I am Sarah Damon, Marcus and Kristy's mom.
My hobby is cooking.  If you want egg rolls, feel free to drop by anytime.  Tee hee.
Hmm?  You are here for the DATA Scan DigiEgg?
There are a variety of DATA Scan DigiEggs according to each digimon type,
such as the dragons, beasts, insects, ores, plants, birds, and devils.
Well, here you go.  Take it to Miki, would you?
All right!  Let's scan this DigiEgg.
I'll give you a practice DigiEgg.  Try scanning it yourself.
To scan DigiEggs, come and speak with me first.  Then, select <Scan DigiEgg>.
You can click "Auto-Assign" or drag the DigiEgg in the inventory that needs scanning.
Once you scan the DigiEgg, bring me whatever item you gain from it.
Curious what you will find?  Well, scan it and find out.  Heh.
Do you know the difference between <Partner Digimons> and <Mercenary Digimons>?
The digimon that you have with you, @<tc:900>#<my_dname>@</tc> should be <Agumon, Lalamon, Gaomon, or Falcomon>.
These are <Partner Digimons>.
If you happen to obtain a mercenary DigiEgg, you can hatch it for a mercenary digimon.
To hatch mercenary DigiEggs, you have to take it to the mercenary hatcher NPC <Incubator> and register it.  You will also need the correct ingredient DATA.
You can get ingredient DATA items from scanning DigiEggs.  Don't you forget!
If you want to become an official Dats member, you'd better listen to what I'm saying.
I am far above the likes of Richard Sampson, you see...
The way Richard deals with the digimon problems is problematic.  He's far too soft.
We can't handle the growth of digimons.  We need to take drastic measures and preemptively eliminate potential problems.
On this point, Director Hashima, the one in charge of Dats, agrees.
If you are a Dats member, it will be in your own best interest to assist me. *snickers*
Get out there and bring me <Dragon Digimon Research Data>.
You should be able to obtain <Dragon Digimon Research Data> from <Koromons> at the <Small Forest Park> or the <Wood Bench Park>.
Greetings!  I am Megumi  Not to be confused with Miki!
I trust that Miki has you well-familiarized with the basics of your tasks at Dats Center.
If you come across <Broken DigiEggs> on your hunt, know that these are <Retrieval DigiEggs>.
You can find <Retrieval DigiEggs> on monster digimons mostly.
You can return them to Dats member <Miki>, or other NPCs that retrieve DigiEggs, for money, so be sure to take them with you.
Now, head out to the Yokohama park and bring me a <Retrieval DigiEgg>.
Hmm...  This is your first run, so... it's probably a good idea to start with Koromons.
Hi, there.  I'm Inoue's mom.  We are a family of three - my husband, Inoue, and myself.
We run a bakery in <Yokohama Village>.  Haha!
If you need bread, come find me anytime.  You need to pay for it, of course.
Hmm...  Some digimons suddenly appeared and they are devouring the precious bread I baked.
I want you to teach them a lesson, so that they won't come near our bakery ever again.
You will find Koromons at the <Small Forest Park> or the <Wood Bench Park>.
Hello!  My name is Minnie.  Just think "tiny", and you'll at least get the sound right.
I am a boxer's precious daughter.  Who's my daddy, you ask?
He's none other than <Pro Boxer> Hayase Harris.  Didn't you know?
Uhmmm...  Anyway, I have a favor to ask.  Wanna hear it?
It has to do with Tsunomons and Upamons.
I saw Tsunomons earlier.  I thought they were cute so I came closer to them.  But, then, they threatened me with their horns.  Give them a good beating for me, will you?
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!  I trust that you know who I am?  I am <Dats Commander Richard Sampson>.
You have handled the digimon conflicts in Yokohama well.
I hereby promote you to the rank of <Official Dats Member>.  I look forward to working with you.
The future holds one trial after another.
Let me give you the <Dats Suit>, the very symbol of an official member.
I hereby request your relentless effort to protect the peace between the <Real World> and the <Digital World>.  I look forward to your future endeavor.
Hello!  I am <Dats Employee Megumi>.
You have finally become an official member.  Congratulations!
I am in charge of transportation to <D-Terminal>.
Speak to me and select <D-Terminal> to get there.
You can get to the Digital World through <D-Terminal>.
The area you are about to enter is a restricted area.  Be careful.  Once again, congratulations on your promotion to the official member status.
We, the <Royal Knights>, are Holy Knight type digimons, the guardians of Network security.
Some say that we are spoken of in the prophecies of old, drawn here by the prophecies in times of great peril in the Digital World.
We do not follow the absolute good, but each of us follows his or her own idea of justice.  This causes internal conflict at times.
We are not an organized group of digimons, usually.  However, our reputation is such that some digimons would pretend to be one of us to take advantage of the fame that comes with our name.
The <Royal Knights> members include such digimons as Omnimon, Gallantmons, Dynasmons, LordKnightmons, UlforceVeedramons, Craniamons, and Kentaurosmons (Sleipmons).
There are more members than that, but this will do for now.
We have one thing in common - we are all holy knight types.  Not all holy knight types belong to the Royal Knights, however.
Just know that we exist to defend the Network.
Omnimon's name comes from the Latin word for "all".  He is the ultimate warrior.
And let me tell you something, and let's keep it between you and me:
Although many digimons don't agree, I consider him the chief of the Royal Knights...  This bit is simply for your reference.
Anyway, your task has nothing to do with that.  You are to bring me Chrome Digizoid.  Get to it!

When you complete the quest, you just may be able to have an audience with him...
Project Ark…

The data of Digimons has now grown to be much more than the predictions of Yggdrasil. An explosion of space, including Digital World, is possible because of the explosive amount of data. the risk of a 'Digital Hazard' is in front of our eyes.

Yggdrasil' worried about the destruction of the world, and made a plan to abandon the old Digital World, and create a new world. The Royal Knights and just a few Digimons worth studying will be moved to the new world.
And... Erasing Digimons that are judged not to be appropriate for the new world. This is Project Ark and X-program executes this plan.

However, the will to survive stood up against X-program. A minority of Digimons changed Digicore themselves and Digicore created 'X antibodies' that can stand up against X-program. 'X antibodies' affected Digicore. Digimons stood up against X-program.
The 'Royal Knights' are directly cutting off Digimons with X antibodies that stand up against X-program... Because of the order of Yggdrasil.
Project Ark is what Yggdrasil thinks justice is. However, who is the justice for...? As a Gallantmon, I do not yet have the answer to what justice is and how I should act.
I awoke a long time ago... But I feel like... I have only just opened my eyes…
Justice according to Yggdrasil? I do not agree. I realized it was wrong when I saw the merciless attacks of Dorugoramons by evolved Death X.
All living things exist to survive. A plan that ignores survival cannot be justice in any way.
I will go back on the road of the sword I chose, in order to make Yggdrasil realize that it is not right.
Another prototype Digimon that will hold me and fight with me... That survived a cruel experiment…
I will walk this road with it.

Title: [Quest] Death X evolution and Blast Evolution

Line.Talk: Yes... X-program is a program that erases Digimons that are not needed in the new world. Directly taking care of X antibody Digimons created by standing up to it was the duty of the 'Royal Knights.'
